audit_items.proof_trace: Both `LegionFixedPriceSale.initialize()` and `LegionSealedBidAuctionSale.initialize()` apply Solady's `initializer` modifier, which tracks an initialized flag in storage and reverts on any second call. The implementation contracts are further protected by `LegionAbstractSale.constructor()` calling `_disableInitializers()`, blocking initialization on the template itself. The factory creates each clone and calls `initialize()` atomically in one transaction (`onlyOwner`), so no race window exists.
